    SELECT a."Id", a."ClassId", a."CreatedDate", a."Description", a."DueDate", a."IsDraft", a."MaxMarks", a."SubjectId", a."Title"
    FROM "Assignments" AS a
    ORDER BY a."CreatedDate" DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS a0
LEFT JOIN "Classes" AS c ON a0."ClassId" = c."Id"
LEFT JOIN "Subjects" AS s ON a0."SubjectId" = s."Id"
ORDER BY a0."CreatedDate" DESC
